prepareRemoteENFn: async function(key){const e=load('enCatalog').find(x=>x.key===key);const rr=await Promise.allSettled([e.path,e.enPath].map(path=>tools.mcp__codex_apps__github_fetch_file({repository_full_name:load('repo'),path,ref:'main'})));for(const r of rr)if(r.status!=='fulfilled'||r.value.isError)throw Error('Source fetch failed');const s=rr[0].value.structuredContent.content,old=rr[1].value.structuredContent.content;store('enCurrent',e);store('enCurrentCS',s);store('enCurrentOld',old);function clean(v){return v.replace(/<[^>]*>/g,'').replace(/&(#x[0-9a-f]+|#\d+|amp|quot|apos|lt|gt|nbsp|ndash|mdash|hellip|times);/gi,(m,a)=>a[0]==='#'?String.fromCodePoint(a[1].toLowerCase()==='x'?parseInt(a.slice(2),16):Number(a.slice(1))):({amp:'&',quot:'"',apos:"'",lt:'<',gt:'>',nbsp:' ',ndash:'–',mdash:'—',hellip:'…',times:'×'}[a.toLowerCase()]||m)).trim();}const pm=s.match(/<(div|section|article)[^>]*class="[^"]*\b(?:beast|catalog)-profile\b[^"]*"[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/\1>/);if(!pm)throw Error('Missing source profile');const profile=[...pm[2].matchAll(/<p[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/p>/g)].map(x=>clean(x[1]));if(profile.length!==3)throw Error('Profile count');const sourceName=clean(s.match(/<h1[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/h1>/)[1]);let body=s.match(/<body[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/body>/)[1].replace(pm[0],'').replace(/<(script|style)[\s\S]*?<\/\1>/g,'').replace(/<!--[\s\S]*?-->/g,'');const unknown=[...new Set(body.split(/<[^>]*>/g).map(clean).filter(x=>x&&/[a-zá-ž]/i.test(x)&&!(x in load('enCommon'))&&x!==sourceName&&!/^Obtížnost \d/.test(x)&&!/^\d+ hráč/.test(x)&&!/^\d+\s*(z|s)$/.test(x)))].sort();const payload=s.match(/<script[^>]*id="catalog-card-data"[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/script>/);text({key,name:clean(old.match(/<h1[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/h1>/)[1]),profile,strings:unknown,oldHeadings:[...old.matchAll(/<h2[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/h2>/g)].map(x=>clean(x[1])),card:payload?JSON.parse(payload[1]):undefined});}
startCIENFn: async function(key,t){if(load('enCurrent').key!==key)throw Error('Wrong current page');store('enInputTranslation',t);const ref=await tools.mcp__codex_apps__github_fetch({url:'https://api.github.com/repos/'+load('repo')+'/git/ref/heads/main'});if(ref.isError)throw Error(JSON.stringify(ref));const head=JSON.parse(ref.structuredContent.content).object.sha;const attempt=(load('ciAttempt')||0)+1;store('ciAttempt',attempt);const tree=await tools.mcp__codex_apps__github_create_tree({repository_full_name:load('repo'),base_tree_sha:head,tree_elements:[{path:'tools/aifa-en/ci-input.json',mode:'100644',type:'blob',content:JSON.stringify({key,translation:t,source:head,attempt})},...(load('saveRemoteHelpers')?[{path:'tools/aifa-en/orchestration-remote.json',mode:'100644',type:'blob',content:JSON.stringify(Object.fromEntries(['prepareRemoteENFn','startCIENFn','waitCIENFn','publishRemoteENFn','completeRemoteENFn','waitENFn','decodeB64Fn'].map(k=>[k,load(k)])))}]:[])]});if(tree.isError)throw Error(JSON.stringify(tree));const commit=await tools.mcp__codex_apps__github_create_commit({repository_full_name:load('repo'),parent_sha:head,tree_sha:tree.structuredContent.sha,message:'Validate complete English page and card: '+t.name});if(commit.isError)throw Error(JSON.stringify(commit));const update=await tools.mcp__codex_apps__github_update_ref({repository_full_name:load('repo'),branch_name:'main',sha:commit.structuredContent.sha,force:false});if(update.isError)throw Error(JSON.stringify(update));store('ciValidationCommit',commit.structuredContent.sha);store('saveRemoteHelpers',false);text({checking:key,commit:commit.structuredContent.sha});}
waitCIENFn: async function(){for(let i=0;i<45;i++){const r=await tools.mcp__codex_apps__github_fetch({url:'https://api.github.com/repos/'+load('repo')+'/actions/runs?per_page=10'});if(r.isError)throw Error(JSON.stringify(r));const run=JSON.parse(r.structuredContent.content).workflow_runs.find(x=>x.head_sha===load('ciValidationCommit')&&x.name==='Validate AIFA English page');if(run?.status==='completed'){const jobs=await tools.mcp__codex_apps__github_fetch_workflow_run_jobs({repo_full_name:load('repo'),run_id:run.id});if(jobs.isError)throw Error(JSON.stringify(jobs));const job=jobs.structuredContent.jobs.find(x=>x.name==='validate');const logs=await tools.mcp__codex_apps__github_fetch_workflow_job_logs({repo_full_name:load('repo'),job_id:job.id});if(logs.isError)throw Error(JSON.stringify(logs));const source=logs.structuredContent.content;store('ciLastLogs',source);if(run.conclusion!=='success')throw Error('CI validation failed: '+source.slice(-5000));if(!source.includes('AIFA_EN_COMPLETE'))throw Error('CI missing result');const encoded=[...source.matchAll(/AIFA_EN_RESULT ([A-Za-z0-9+/=]+)/g)].map(x=>x[1]).join('');const result=JSON.parse(eval('('+load('decodeB64Fn')+')')(encoded));if(result.key!==load('enCurrent').key)throw Error('CI wrong page');store('ciValidatedResult',result);text({validated:result.key,checks:source.split('\n').filter(x=>/paragraphs|overflow/.test(x)).map(x=>x.replace(/^\S+ /,''))});return;}await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,10000));}throw Error('CI validation still pending');}

waitENFn: async function(){for(let i=0;i<35;i++){const r=await tools.mcp__codex_apps__github_fetch({url:'https://api.github.com/repos/'+load('repo')+'/actions/runs?per_page=10'});const run=JSON.parse(r.structuredContent.content).workflow_runs.find(x=>x.head_sha===load('enLastCommit'));if(run?.status==='completed'){if(run.conclusion!=='success')throw Error('Publication failed '+run.conclusion);const e=load('enCatalog').find(x=>x.key===load('enLastKey'));const v=await tools.mcp__codex_apps__github_fetch_file({repository_full_name:load('repo'),path:e.enPath,ref:load('enLastCommit')});if(v.structuredContent.content.trim()!==load('enLastHTML'))throw Error('saved page mismatch');store('enPublished',load('enLastCommit'));text({published:e.key,verified:load('enDone').length});return;}await new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(resolve,10000));}throw Error('Publication still pending');}
decodeB64Fn: function(encoded){const chars="ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/";let acc=0,bits=0,escaped="";for(const c of encoded){const n=chars.indexOf(c);if(n<0)continue;acc=(acc<<6)|n;bits+=6;if(bits>=8){bits-=8;escaped+="%"+((acc>>bits)&255).toString(16).padStart(2,"0");}}return decodeURIComponent(escaped);}
